name: Flaco
bio: Founded the block. Rarely talks, everyone listens.
development:
Grew up on the block and started the back stairs meetings.

Became the voice everyone trusts. Settles disputes before they start.

name: La Sombra
bio: Runs patrol schedules and faction relations.
development: Joined in the first month. Took over patrols after the first block war and built the schedule the crew still uses.

name: Chino
bio: Handles money and the corner store.
development: Started by running errands for the store owner. Now runs the store and keeps the books.

name: Duke
bio: Fought both block wars. Right hand on the street.
development: Came in during Year 2 and proved himself in both block wars. Sponsors most new rookies.

name: Smoky
bio: Eyes on the back alley. Knows every shortcut.
development: Quiet and watchful. Mapped every alley and rooftop around the block.

name: Pelon
development: Started as a runner. Now handles every pickup and getaway.

name: Viper
development: Earned the door post after a quiet, spotless first year.

name: Lil Rey
bio: On probation. Works hard, asks a lot.
development: Just joined. Learning the block and the rules.

name: Gordo
development: Sponsored by Duke. Proving himself with deliveries.
